מילים באבן – renderings, conventions, gates

Binding for every text of the corpus (guidelines §6.6). The nearest model is the Ugaritic corpus
(../מיתוסים-אוגריתיים/renderings.md): a cousin language, where the cognate is chosen whenever the meaning matches,
and the danger is understanding too much.

1. Transcription and transliteration

  • Square script, diplomatic: no final letter forms (the scripts have none); · = the original's word divider
    (dot or short stroke); | = the Mesha stele's vertical stroke; [ ] = restored (the base edition's restorations);
    [...] / [..] = lost letters; a letter followed by U+05C4 ׄ = an uncertain letter (Compston's overline; Wikipedia's
    "h/w"); {n} = a numeral sign (Punic), written in digits.
  • Latin: generated by stone_tools.py translit (ʾ b g d h w z ḥ ṭ y k l m n s ʿ p ṣ q r š t; an uncertain letter
    with a ring above, å). Never typed by hand.

2. The vocalized reading (Hebrew, Moabite)

  • The consonants are the inscription's, in order; the vowels are a proposal written with Tiberian signs as notation.
    Final letter forms, maqaf, spaces and punctuation are ours. A word broken across a line ends / begins with ־.
  • Moabite forms vocalized as Moabite: plural ‎-īn (מְלָכִן, שְׁלֹשִׁן, אֲלָפִן); 3ms suffix ‎-ō(h) written ה
    (אַרְצֹה, בְּנֹה, לֹה); אָנֹךְ "I" (ʾnk – Moabite writes final long vowels, so no ‑ī); שָׁת "year";
    בָּנִתִי "I built" (no medial yod); the Gt אֶלְתַּחֵם; קִר "town"; אֵן "there is not"; הֻא "he".
  • Judahite / Israelite forms: the 3ms suffix -ō written ה (עַבְדֹּה, אֲשֵׁרָתֹה); the 2ms suffix written ‑k
    (עַבְדְּךָ, אֵלֶיכָ); a doubled kk written once (יְבָרֶכָּ – non-final כ with qamats, so that the letters match);
    the northern ‑yaw names (אֲמַרְיָו) beside the Judahite ‑yāhū (הוֹשַׁעְיָהוּ).
  • The Name יהוה is never vocalized (in Mesha, ʿAjrud, Ketef Hinnom), nor is a broken יה־ / ־וה.
  • Uncertain words stay unvocalized (Mesha 31 בת וק אש, 33 דה, 34 שדק), and the apparatus gives the readings.
  • Glosses only in פירוק, for words a modern reader would misread: Moabite קר "town" (not "cold"), רית,
    אשוח "reservoir", רחמת "young women" (not "wombs"), גרנ "boys" (not "threshing floors"), שת "year",
    משמעת "subject"; Hebrew ענה ל־ "testify", נקי מ־ "free of", ואמלא = "and if not".

3. Names (first occurrence vocalized)

Original Hebrew Note
mšʿ מֵשַׁע (reading) the Bible's מֵישַׁע (2 Kgs 3:4) in the apparatus
kmš כְּמֹשׁ
ʿštr kmš עַשְׁתַּר כְּמֹשׁ a male Ashtar, never עַשְׁתֹּרֶת
ʿmry עָמְרִי
dybn, mhdbʾ, ʿṭrt, nbh, yhṣ, ḥwrnn, bʿlmʿn, qrytn, ʿrʿr, bṣr, bt bmt, bt dbltn דִּיבֹן, מְהֵדְבָא, עֲטָרֹת, נְבֹה, יַהַץ, חוֹרֹנֵן, בַּעַלְמְעֹן, קִרְיָתֵן, עֲרֹעֵר, בֶּצֶר, בֵּת בָּמֹת, בֵּת דִּבְלָתֵן Moabite spellings kept in the reading; the biblical forms in the apparatus
qrḥh קַרְחֹה Dibon's citadel (?)
šmrn, tmn שֹׁמְרֹן, תֵּמָן "YHWH of Samaria / of Teman"
ḥlṣbʿl, bdtnt, bdʾšmn חִלֶּצְבַּעַל, בּוֹדְתִּנִּית, בּוֹדְאֶשְׁמוּן the Carthaginian suffetes (MT)

The echo tag on a proper name (the lead's rule, 2026-11-02; guidelines §6.4): in a הקבלה tag on a place, a people, a
person or a god, [cognate] when the name is the same word as the Bible's (Mesha / מֵישַׁע, Dibon, Medeba, Gad, Kemosh,
Ataroth, Nebo, Baal-meon, Kiriathaim, Jahaz, Arnon, Hoshaiah …: the same name, even as a loan or a transcription);
[equivalent] only when the Bible names the same thing by another word (Deut 33:2's Sinai / Seir / Paran for ʿAjrud's
Teman). 2026-11-02 harmonization (the Round 5 finalization): applied to every tag of the corpus – changed from
[equivalent] to [cognate]: MS 1 (Mesha, 2 Kgs 3:4), MS 2 (Dibon, Num 32:34), MS 8 (Medeba, Josh 13:9), MS 9 (Baal-meon,
Num 32:38), MS 10 (Kiriathaim, Jer 48:1), MS 19 (Jahaz, Num 21:23), MH 7 (Hoshaiah, Neh 12:32); no > line changed.

4. Punic translation: renderings and gates (mode translation; RESERVED_PUN, TRAPS_PUN in the tool)

Cognates kept (the meaning matches), each reserved for its Punic word: kll כָּלִיל [cognate]; šlm שֶׁלֶם
(שֶׁלֶם כָּלִיל); khn כֹּהֵן; zbḥ זֶבַח / זָבַח, bʿl hzbḥ בַּעַל הַזֶּבַח; mnḥt מִנְחָה; ʿrt עוֹר;
ṣpr צִפּוֹר; dl דַּל; mqnʾ מִקְנֶה; qdš קֹדֶשׁ; šʾr שְׁאֵר "flesh" (always vocalized); mšʾt
מַשְׂאֵת "payment" (2 Chr 24:6); ʾgrt אֲגוֹרָה (1 Sam 2:36); špṭ שׁוֹפֵט; bll בְּלִיל; mrzḥ מַרְזֵחַ;
pʿmm פְּעָמִים "feet" (always vocalized); ʿgl עֵגֶל; ybl יוֹבֵל "ram" (Josh 6:4; vocalized); ʾyl אַיָּל
(Cooke's "hart"; vocalized); ʾmr אִמַּר "lamb" (Ezra 6:9; vocalized); gdʾ גְּדִי; ʿz עֵז; ḥlb חָלָב /
חֵלֶב (both always vocalized); šmn שֶׁמֶן; špḥ מִשְׁפָּחָה; nʿnš נֶעֱנַשׁ; ḥbr חָבֵר.
By sense: ʾlp בָּקָר (as Ugaritic alp; Hebrew אֶלֶף is "thousand"); ʿlt pn נוֹסָף עַל (never עוֹלָה);
ykn / kn יִהְיֶה / וְהָיָה; ʾš (rel.) אֲשֶׁר; ʾšm (pl. of ʾš) הָאֲנָשִׁים (never אָשָׁם); ʾdmm
אָדָם; ps לוּחַ; ktbt כְּתוּבוֹת; ʾybl / bl לֹא / בַּל; mnm מְאוּמָה; ʿt r בְּעֵת הָרַב; ʾlm
הָאֵלִים (as Ugaritic ilm; Phoenician may mean a singular "god": noted).
Transliterated (meaning unknown), italic and vocalized: ṣwʿt צַוְעַת, qṣrt קְצָרוֹת, yṣlt
יְצֻלּוֹת, šlbm שְׁלַבִּים, ʾgnn אַגְנָן, ṣṣ צִיץ, šṣp שַׁצָּף, ḥzt חֲזָת, zr
זָר (a coin; vocalized), mzrḥ מִזְרַח (a guild; vocalized), qdmt קַדְמַת.
Never in a line (Leviticus words the tariff does not have; the absences are findings): עוֹלָה, חַטָּאת,
אָשָׁם, תְּנוּפָה, תְּרוּמָה, חָזֶה, שׁוֹק, קָרְבָּן, אִשֶּׁה, נִיחוֹחַ, the root כפר, בִּכּוּרִים, רֵאשִׁית,
מֹלֶךְ.
Fixed formula (MT 4, 6, 8, 10): וְהָיוּ הָעוֹר וְהַשְּׁלַבִּים וְהַפְּעָמִים וְיֶתֶר הַשְּׁאֵר לְבַעַל הַזֶּבַח.

5. For the Aramaic texts still to come (Fekheriye, Sefire)

Fix before their first line: ṣlm צֶלֶם and dmwt דְּמוּת [cognate; Gen 1:26, 5:3] reserved for them (and
דְּמוּת never for any other word); ʿdy עֲדֵי (with the debated עֵדֹת and the Akkadian adê אֲמָנָה of the
law corpus in the apparatus – a split for the lead); the futility-curse formula; gwgl "canal-inspector"; the gods'
names transcribed (הַדַּד as in the Ugaritic corpus).

6. Traps (always vocalized, or avoided)

מזרח (guild / east), שאר (flesh / rest), חלב (milk / fat), אמר (lamb / said), איל / אייל, פעמים
(feet / times), יובל (ram / jubilee), זר (coin / stranger) – checked by the tool in translation lines. In readings:
קר / קִר "town" (not "cold"), הא = הֻא (not the interjection), ימה = יָמֵהֻ "his days" (not "seaward").
